message:
2 helper(s) imported from a relative module under a name no vocabulary can match:
      card.spec.ts:2 — `styleOf as colourOf`, imported from `./support/css`: an alias, which writes no helper's own name
      tint.spec.ts:2 — `default as colourOf`, imported from `./support/css`: an alias, which writes no helper's own name
    Every
why: The hovered card's race, read through `styleOf` imported as `colourOf`, and the second card's through the module's default export bound as `colourOf` — the name `support/swatch.ts` gives a lookup of its own. A vocabulary matches a helper by the name a call writes, so as far as point 3 can tell both reads are that lookup, which reads nothing, and the races go by unreported. An alias that is called is refused whatever the corpus defines under it, and a default binding is one by construction: neither call writes the helper's own name.
